notes.title: Notes
notes.untitledHint: Notes are available only after the file is saved for the first time.
notes.suspendedHint: The note is suspended because the companion file is corrupted.
outline.title: Table of Contents
settings.panelOrder.title: Panel order
settings.panelOrder.hint: Order of the panel toggles in the View menu (Panels submenu) and the status bar; applies to both places at once and to the whole app. Changes take effect on Apply or OK.
settings.sidebar.title: Sidebar
settings.sidebar.hint: Panel arrangement, applies to the whole app. Changes take effect on Apply or OK; drag and drop directly in the sidebar takes effect immediately.
settings.sidebar.iconHeadings: Headings as icon instead of text (narrower sidebar)
settings.sidebar.heightMode.hint: With «Height per panel» each panel keeps its own height, so paging through a tab group changes the height of the block. With «Fixed height per group» a tab group keeps its height, and the panels below stay in place.
settings.sidebarVariants.title: Variants
settings.sidebarVariants.hint: Named sidebar arrangements. Saving freezes the arrangement and panel visibility; applying replaces the current arrangement immediately. Later rearrangements do not change a variant; overwriting is the explicit way back.
settings.sidebarVariants.areaHint: Area variants live in the area file, travel with the area folder, and apply only when the area is open. Saving stores directly in the area; applying replaces the current arrangement immediately.
sidebarVariants.errorDuplicateName: A variant with this name already exists.
sidebarVariants.picker.title: Apply sidebar variant
